correctness.rationale: Verified every essential inference by independent re-derivation and re-execution. Local bound 0 confirmed by exact 64-case enumeration (20 saturators, re-ran). Werner reduction I(v)=-1+vS/4 confirmed from maximally-mixed marginals, P(AiBj)=(1-v aiBj)/4, and sum c=4. Achievability S=5 confirmed term-by-term (rows 2+2+1) with exact Fraction cosines and float dot-product cross-check (S=5.0); singlet value 1/4 matches Collins-Gisin. Upper bound Q<=5 confirmed: B-side elimination to sum|gj| is exact (optimal bj=gj/|gj|); u=a1+a2, w=a1-a2 with u perp w; a3-maximum 2*sqrt(|u|^2+1) via squared-sum/product bound, attainable by a3 perp u; reduction to g(t)=2*sqrt(t^2+1)+sqrt(4-t^2), t in [0,2], |w|=sqrt(4-t^2); chain 2*sqrt(t^2+1)<=5-sqrt(4-t^2) <=> 2*sqrt(4-t^2)<=5-t^2 <=> 0<=(t^2-3)^2 with both squarings justified by strictly positive sides (RHS>=3, 5-t^2>=1). Equality at t=sqrt(3) attainable (a1,a2 at 60 deg, a3 perp u; draft settings satisfy this). Threshold v*=4/5, gap to 1/sqrt(2) in (0.092,0.094), (4/5)^2=16/25>1/2 all check. Random-search corroboration (200k starts, optimal-B value 4.9999959) supports global optimum. Proof is exact hand-checkable algebra; seesaw 2e5-start convergence is labeled corroboration, not the proof. Scope honestly limited to qubit projective measurements; no overclaim to POVM/higher-dimension.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp. Collins-Gisin quant-ph/0306129 introduces I3322 as the unique 3322 facet, gives singlet settings/value 1/4 (same achievability point), exhibits isolated I3322-without-CHSH states, and remarks Werner violation only for p>3/4: a one-sided uncertified observation with no upper bound, no curve, no v* value. Pal-Vertesi 1006.3032 studies the unconstrained-dimension maximum (qubit 0.25, NPA ~0.25087538, infinite-dim optimum) not the Werner visibility slice. Augusiak et al. 1405.7321 reviews Werner locality for CHSH/standard models with no I3322 Werner threshold. NPA hierarchy 0803.4290 is method only. Live arXiv searches on 2026-09-09: 'I3322 Werner' 0 hits; '"I3322" Werner visibility' 0 hits; 'I3322' full-text 7 hits (Mortimer, Fan, Bernards x2, Pomarico, Pal-Vertesi, plus 2026 Douglas spatial-attainment paper) none mapping a Werner-family I3322 visibility curve or stating v*=4/5. The recent Douglas 2609.05555 notes two-qubit maximum exactly 1/4 but does not state or prove the Werner threshold. The matching upper-bound proof Q<=5 and exact threshold v*=4/5 require fresh optimization and are not mechanically implied by Horodecki (CHSH-only) or by the singlet achievability point.

value.rationale: Exact invariant of a specific natural object, motivated before computation. Object: canonical one-parameter Werner family W(v) (U otimes U-invariant separability/locality testbed) paired with I3322 (unique minimal facet beyond CHSH). Invariant: exact qubit-projective critical visibility v*=4/5 with I_max(v)=-1+5v/4 and explicit optimal settings, deciding the Werner instance of the Collins-Gisin relevance question as no-separation (strictly weaker than CHSH, gap ~0.093). Value was not known (only one-sided p>3/4 remark) and not mechanically implied (no Horodecki-type formula for 3 settings). Future researchers can reasonably need the precise fact as a benchmark for 3-setting Werner analyses, device-independent work, and NPA case studies. Honestly scoped to projective qubits with higher-dimensional/POVM slice left open; per shared standard an incomplete census described honestly does not erase an independently valuable exact headline, and no general criterion or completed census is demanded.
